prior_allocation_preservation.v1_formal_allocation_02: HOLD_AUDIT_INTEGRITY; candidate omitted W1 update; raw/audit and all predecessor evidence unchanged on main

H_T_D_C_U.H: After correcting the missing W1 update, candidate training and independent raw-only refit produce byte-identical parameter arrays from identical reconstructed rows and init; then diversified position support yields >=0.20 greater positive ACCEPT in position_random than spatial_block on the same fitted weights, conditional on competence/false-accept gates.
H_T_D_C_U.T_construction: One balanced 160-row training dataset at construction seed 65903001 and init 65903002; run the full eight-test suite in one isolated pinned OrbStack container; the parity test fits the candidate and independently coded auditor exactly once each and includes W1-update omission sensitivity.
H_T_D_C_U.T_formal: Only after construction PASS, one fresh formal candidate and one independent auditor in distinct containers. Five new seeds 659101..659105; control center-only and diversified five-center MLP arms; base, position_random and spatial_block cohorts; 512 positive and 512 fixed-distractor negatives per seed/cohort; 64 distinct centers per non-base cohort; eight noise rows per center; ten total candidate model fits, then ten independent refits.

D.construction_pass: PASS_TRAINING_IMPLEMENTATION_REPRODUCIBLE only if 8/8 tests pass, W1 changes, all four arrays and hashes exactly match, candidate/auditor fits each equal one, and the frozen image/runtime gates hold.
D.formal_pass: H_PASS_SCOPED only if independent audit has zero errors, both arms' base positive ACCEPT >=0.80, false ACCEPT <=0.05 across both arms/all cohorts, every spatial block has >=8 centers and >=100 positive rows, and diversified pooled random-minus-block positive ACCEPT gap >=0.20.
D.formal_fail: H_FAIL_SCOPED if all audit/competence/false-accept/support gates pass and the gap is <0.20.
D.hold: HOLD_AUDIT_INTEGRITY on any reconstruction mismatch; HOLD_MODEL_INCOMPETENT_OR_FALSE_ACCEPT if competence/false-accept fails; construction parity mismatch is HOLD_TRAINING_IMPLEMENTATION.
D.stop: Any frozen source/main/image/context/output/container-name failure before launch is STOP; any candidate/auditor nonzero or timeout is retained STOP; no retries or replacements.

H_T_D_C_U.C: Same deterministic rows, paired seeds/init, fixed renderer/threshold and independently implemented refit. Position_random and spatial_block remain interpolation and extrapolation envelopes, not estimator-bias estimates. V1 evidence and consumed seeds are not changed or repeated.
H_T_D_C_U.U: Synthetic single-renderer evidence only; does not establish production spatial autocorrelation, real GUI robustness, human performance, safety, authority or product benefit.
